title: alchemilla transiens var. corsica
intro: Alchemilla transiens var. corsica, commonly known as Corsican Lady's Mantle, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating wounds, skin conditions, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla transiens var. corsica include astringent, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
